description.value: A Tim Hortons franchise located at 20250 88th Ave in Langley, BC, offering coffee, baked goods, wraps, soups, and other quick-service meals. As one of Canada's most ubiquitous roadside stops, it provides dine-in seating alongside drive-through and takeout options. Touring cyclists will find food and WiFi available here, making it a practical mid-ride stop along this corridor.
